test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The coach said / that Shreyas / had practicing on / the lawn tennis court.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **'had practicing on.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase is** 'had been practicing'** instead of **'had practicing.'**
 
• The error is in the verb tense as** 'had practicing'** is not a grammatically correct form.
 
• In past perfect continuous tense, we use **"had been"** followed by the **base form of the verb + "ing".**
 
• So, **"had been practicing" **is the correct form in this context.
 
• The sentence should read as *'The coach said that Shreyas **had been practicing on**__ the lawn tennis court.'*
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
